description: This file defines a template class 'ScreenConnector' which manages screen frame processing, callback setting, and frame injection for a screen sharing or rendering system within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It interacts with various components such as WaylandScreenConnector, HostModeCtrl, and handles frame queues, including support for confirmation UI rendering.

classes.name: ScreenConnector
classes.description: A template class managing screen frame processing, callback registration, and frame queue handling for a specific ProcessedFrameType, supporting interaction with Wayland and confirmation UI.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function used to process frames, and registers a frame callback with the WaylandScreenConnector.

methods.name: InjectFrame
methods.description: Injects a new frame into the processing pipeline, unless in confirmation UI mode.

methods.name: IsCallbackSet
methods.description: Checks if the frame processing callback has been set.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Sets a display event callback on the WaylandScreenConnector.

methods.name: OnNextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the next processed frame from the internal queue.

methods.name: RenderConfirmationUi
methods.description: Handles rendering of confirmation UI frames, processing them via the callback, and pushing to the confirmation UI queue.
